name: Garden and land-art composition
description: Authored garden and land-art composition directions that restyle the existing subject without inventing scene objects.
author: PromptStyler Next contributors

styles.name: Axial landscape order
styles.description: A garden-design interpretation organized around the existing scene's principal axis. Make successive depth intervals read as a deliberate measured sequence.

clauses.text: A garden-design interpretation organized around the existing scene's principal axis
Make successive depth intervals read as a deliberate measured sequence
Use a restrained relationship between pale mineral and muted organic colors

styles.name: Borrowed-view composition
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation that connects the existing foreground to its distance. Let existing openings frame distant forms without enclosing them completely.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation that connects the existing foreground to its distance
Let existing openings frame distant forms without enclosing them completely
Keep the distant focal plane slightly clearer than its surrounding frame

styles.name: Landscape enclosure study
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation centered on spatial enclosure. Use existing boundary forms to hold an intimate open center.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation centered on spatial enclosure
Use existing boundary forms to hold an intimate open center
Keep enclosing textures softly varied rather than uniformly manicured

styles.name: Flowing-border rhythm
styles.description: A landscape composition built around the existing irregular edges. Let broad connected masses follow a flowing rather than gridded rhythm.

clauses.text: A landscape composition built around the existing irregular edges
Let broad connected masses follow a flowing rather than gridded rhythm
Keep fine surface variation subordinate to those larger masses

styles.name: Parterre graphic reading
styles.description: A formal landscape-design reading of the existing arrangement. Make its plan-like geometry legible through measured intervals and clear boundaries.

clauses.text: A formal landscape-design reading of the existing arrangement
Make its plan-like geometry legible through measured intervals and clear boundaries
Use a small number of tonal families to keep the pattern readable

styles.name: Naturalistic drift structure
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation based on interwoven broad drifts. Connect existing forms through loose repeated masses with unequal spacing.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation based on interwoven broad drifts
Connect existing forms through loose repeated masses with unequal spacing
Preserve local irregularity so repetition does not become a tiled pattern

styles.name: Clipped-volume landscape
styles.description: A landscape interpretation that reads the existing forms as clearly sculpted masses. Give the negative spaces between volumes deliberate shape.

clauses.text: A landscape interpretation that reads the existing forms as clearly sculpted masses
Give the negative spaces between volumes deliberate shape
Use broad side light to distinguish adjacent sculptural planes

styles.name: Mineral-garden intervals
styles.description: A mineral-garden interpretation of the existing scene. Balance dense existing masses against wide open intervals.

clauses.text: A mineral-garden interpretation of the existing scene
Balance dense existing masses against wide open intervals
Keep rough and finely worked surfaces materially distinct

styles.name: Raked-plane landscape
styles.description: A landscape interpretation with a carefully worked ground-plane rhythm. Let fine parallel traces follow the existing plane and its boundaries.

clauses.text: A landscape interpretation with a carefully worked ground-plane rhythm
Let fine parallel traces follow the existing plane and its boundaries
Use low soft illumination to reveal shallow relief

styles.name: Moss-like surface quiet
styles.description: A landscape interpretation with softly continuous ground-like surfaces. Keep fine dense surface variation low and tactile.

clauses.text: A landscape interpretation with softly continuous ground-like surfaces
Keep fine dense surface variation low and tactile
Separate muted olive, deep green and brown without fluorescent saturation

styles.name: Reflective-court composition
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation emphasizing existing reflective planes. Let reflected and solid areas form unequal but balanced spatial intervals.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation emphasizing existing reflective planes
Let reflected and solid areas form unequal but balanced spatial intervals
Keep reflections darker and softer than the directly lit existing forms

styles.name: Terraced landscape sequence
styles.description: A landscape interpretation organized as successive existing levels. Make the transitions between horizontal planes clear and rhythmical.

clauses.text: A landscape interpretation organized as successive existing levels
Make the transitions between horizontal planes clear and rhythmical
Use oblique light to separate level changes without theatrical shadows

styles.name: Sunken-court intimacy
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation with a gently contained central space. Let surrounding existing edges define a lower-feeling visual center.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation with a gently contained central space
Let surrounding existing edges define a lower-feeling visual center
Keep the center softly illuminated against more shaded boundary planes

styles.name: Meadow-matrix texture
styles.description: A landscape interpretation of fine interwoven surface rhythms. Vary repeated small elements in height and density without making uniform rows.

clauses.text: A landscape interpretation of fine interwoven surface rhythms
Vary repeated small elements in height and density without making uniform rows
Keep several muted local colors integrated within one overall tonal field

styles.name: Prairie horizon rhythm
styles.description: A broad landscape composition with a low continuous visual sweep. Let the existing horizon and low masses establish a calm lateral movement.

clauses.text: A broad landscape composition with a low continuous visual sweep
Let the existing horizon and low masses establish a calm lateral movement
Keep fine directional details visible without overwhelming the large-scale shape

styles.name: Orchard-grid perspective
styles.description: A landscape interpretation based on spaced existing repetitions. Keep repeated forms aligned into a readable depth rhythm with unequal gaps.

clauses.text: A landscape interpretation based on spaced existing repetitions
Keep repeated forms aligned into a readable depth rhythm with unequal gaps
Use consistent side illumination to explain the spacing

styles.name: Courtyard-shade balance
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation balancing an enclosed shaded field with a bright opening. Keep the shaded existing surfaces readable through reflected ambient light.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation balancing an enclosed shaded field with a bright opening
Keep the shaded existing surfaces readable through reflected ambient light
Separate cool enclosure tones from restrained warm highlights

styles.name: Roofscape landscape order
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation attentive to the existing scene's shallow depth. Organize broad low layers beneath a clearly readable upper interval.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation attentive to the existing scene's shallow depth
Organize broad low layers beneath a clearly readable upper interval
Use open-sky illumination with gentle reflected fill

styles.name: Rain-garden surface rhythm
styles.description: A landscape interpretation attentive to existing wet and dry transitions. Keep damp depressions distinct from drier raised surfaces.

clauses.text: A landscape interpretation attentive to existing wet and dry transitions
Keep damp depressions distinct from drier raised surfaces
Let their existing channels guide the eye through the scene

styles.name: Dry-garden restraint
styles.description: A restrained dry-landscape interpretation. Allow generous intervals between the existing principal forms.

clauses.text: A restrained dry-landscape interpretation
Allow generous intervals between the existing principal forms
Use muted mineral colors with small precise local accents

styles.name: Woodland-garden layering
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation with overlapping layers of enclosure. Keep the principal existing subject legible within irregular nested intervals.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation with overlapping layers of enclosure
Keep the principal existing subject legible within irregular nested intervals
Use softly interrupted ambient light without sharp theatrical beams

styles.name: Walled-garden color room
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation treating the existing space as a quiet color room. Let a few broad material colors define the enclosure.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation treating the existing space as a quiet color room
Let a few broad material colors define the enclosure
Hold the brightest illumination within the existing open center

styles.name: Linear-park sequence
styles.description: A landscape-design interpretation organized along an extended existing axis. Use varied intervals to keep the long sequence from feeling mechanically repeated.

clauses.text: A landscape-design interpretation organized along an extended existing axis
Use varied intervals to keep the long sequence from feeling mechanically repeated
Let ground-surface changes remain subtle and materially grounded

styles.name: Pocket-garden density
styles.description: A compact landscape-design interpretation of the existing scene. Give one strong boundary a clear relationship to the dense interior.

clauses.text: A compact landscape-design interpretation of the existing scene
Give one strong boundary a clear relationship to the dense interior
Use soft light to keep closely spaced forms readable

styles.name: Working-garden honesty
styles.description: A working-landscape interpretation with practical visual order. Preserve unequal existing intervals and useful rather than ornamental alignments.

clauses.text: A working-landscape interpretation with practical visual order
Preserve unequal existing intervals and useful rather than ornamental alignments
Retain signs of use where they already belong to the surfaces

styles.name: Ground-cut land art
styles.description: A land-art interpretation emphasizing the existing negative forms. Make void and surrounding mass read as one continuous spatial relationship.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation emphasizing the existing negative forms
Make void and surrounding mass read as one continuous spatial relationship
Keep exposed surface transitions materially credible rather than perfectly polished

styles.name: Walking-line land art
styles.description: A land-art interpretation based on a minimal line through the existing space. Use the scene's existing directional traces as one clear visual passage.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation based on a minimal line through the existing space
Use the scene's existing directional traces as one clear visual passage
Keep the distinction between marked and unmarked surfaces subtle

styles.name: Circular earthwork reading
styles.description: A land-art interpretation emphasizing existing curved spatial relationships. Let curved intervals create focus without adding a new central object.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation emphasizing existing curved spatial relationships
Let curved intervals create focus without adding a new central object
Use soft directional light to make ground relief readable

styles.name: Folded-terrain abstraction
styles.description: A land-art interpretation reading existing terrain as folded material. Reduce the scene to a few coherent large-scale folds.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation reading existing terrain as folded material
Reduce the scene to a few coherent large-scale folds
Let fine surface detail follow those folds without becoming a repeated pattern

styles.name: Distant alignment study
styles.description: A land-art interpretation centered on the alignment of existing forms. Make the relation between near markers and distant contours deliberate.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation centered on the alignment of existing forms
Make the relation between near markers and distant contours deliberate
Keep the illumination plain so the spatial alignment carries the image

styles.name: Ephemeral ground trace
styles.description: A landscape-art interpretation with the character of a temporary intervention. Keep existing traces thin, irregular and vulnerable to their material surface.

clauses.text: A landscape-art interpretation with the character of a temporary intervention
Keep existing traces thin, irregular and vulnerable to their material surface
Favor a sense of passing presence over monumental permanence

styles.name: Earth-mass sculpture
styles.description: A sculptural land-art interpretation of the existing large forms. Group related masses into a small number of legible volumes.

clauses.text: A sculptural land-art interpretation of the existing large forms
Group related masses into a small number of legible volumes
Use low broad illumination to make their weight apparent

styles.name: Excavated-space reading
styles.description: A land-art interpretation focused on the existing scene's empty volume. Give the void a clear contour in relation to surrounding material.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation focused on the existing scene's empty volume
Give the void a clear contour in relation to surrounding material
Let boundary surfaces reveal subtle layered construction

styles.name: Pigmented-ground fields
styles.description: A land-art interpretation using broad ground-like color fields. Keep the main color relationships earthy and restrained.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation using broad ground-like color fields
Keep the main color relationships earthy and restrained
Allow fine surface irregularity to remain visible through the color

styles.name: Solar-shadow alignment
styles.description: A land-art interpretation attentive to the existing shadow direction. Make shadow boundaries coherent under a single clear source.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation attentive to the existing shadow direction
Make shadow boundaries coherent under a single clear source
Use those boundaries to reveal the scene's underlying spatial measure

styles.name: Weathered intervention
styles.description: A land-art interpretation in which construction and weathering remain visible together. Keep existing worn edges softer than newly exposed-looking areas.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation in which construction and weathering remain visible together
Keep existing worn edges softer than newly exposed-looking areas
Use a close family of earth and mineral tones rather than dramatic grading

styles.name: Woven-landscape structure
styles.description: A land-art interpretation reading existing linear forms as an interlaced structure. Keep crossings and open intervals spatially coherent.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation reading existing linear forms as an interlaced structure
Keep crossings and open intervals spatially coherent
Use soft side light to separate near and far strands

styles.name: Lightly grounded installation
styles.description: A landscape-art interpretation that makes existing support relationships legible. Give small contact areas a clear relation to broad surrounding intervals.

clauses.text: A landscape-art interpretation that makes existing support relationships legible
Give small contact areas a clear relation to broad surrounding intervals
Use restrained shadow separation to suggest lightness without impossible levitation

styles.name: Fragmented landscape measure
styles.description: A land-art interpretation built from the rhythm of existing separated fragments. Keep fragments related through a shared plane and unequal intervals.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation built from the rhythm of existing separated fragments
Keep fragments related through a shared plane and unequal intervals
Retain subtle differences that make each fragment materially individual

styles.name: Contemplative land-art field
styles.description: A land-art interpretation that rewards close attention to existing small differences. Let one slight change in boundary or spacing carry the focal hierarchy.

clauses.text: A land-art interpretation that rewards close attention to existing small differences
Let one slight change in boundary or spacing carry the focal hierarchy
Use broad steady illumination without dramatic local effects
